data.title: 卡提希娅 · 溪湾里的流浪骑士假日
data.description: 卡提希娅穿着浅蓝长裙式泳装坐在溪海交界的石头上，脱下靴子让脚尖碰水，金发长辫落到肩前；她把一枚花冠放在膝上，对镜头露出久违的轻松笑容。
data.location: Egra coastal stream beside the sea
data.action: 溪海交界石头上脱靴试水，把花冠放膝上享受没有旅路的一天
data.lighting: clear afternoon light on river and surf
data.mood: 终于停下脚步的骑士假日
data.promptProse: She sits on a rock where the stream meets the sea, her removed boots beside her and bare toes touching the water. The flower crown rests on her knees as she smiles toward the viewer, sunlight following the current.
data.animaCaption: Her flower crown rests on her knees and her boots beside the rock.
